description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=794422), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8435011)

Joo-young, a reporter on the verge of being fired, tries to land a scoop by resorting to "trash journalism," but it isn't easy. Then, a tabloid accidentally catches her eye... It claims that Stephanie Jin, a top celebrity famous who remains single and childless, is actually a mother! 

Desperate for a scoop, Joo-young decides to infiltrate B-Town to uncover Stephanie's secret...! 

What  is the truth behind this single-mother scandal?
